description: MacBook Pro 14-inch M1 Pro (j314s, t6000) on mx-mac: raw host answers for record mode
source: Real evidence from the M1 Pro, 2026-09-12: reviews/pr-9835/m1-hardware.log and m1-validation.md (uname, model, PCI, Hyprland input devices, Wi-Fi address). No kernel log or device-tree dump of the M1 exists yet; the v0.1 dogfood run records them. The package, encryption, first-boot, mac-check, GPU, battery and CPU answers were never captured on the M1: they are reconstructed from what is known of the install (mx-mac, GRUB, linux-asahi) and noted as such. The inventory answers come from the booted kernel's own package, linux-asahi 7.1.13.asahi1-1 and its headers (device tree, module aliases, build config).
pseudonymized: Committed evidence is pseudonymized: every Wi-Fi network name, MAC address, IP address, UUID, boot id and account name in it was swapped for a fake of the same shape before commit, so the corpus exercises the scrubber on real log formats without publishing the real values. 'forbidden' lists the identifiers (decoys and lab hostnames) that must never survive into a recording or report.
